description: Composes wedding invitation text for a hosting situation and formality, using supplied names, event details and optional reception wording. With no scenario, it lists available options. Wording follows etiquette conventions rather than legal requirements.

child_relationship.description: Relationship word for the hosts’ child. Defaults to child for divorced-parents, daughter for brides-parents and son for grooms-parents.

date.description: Date as it should read, e.g. "Saturday, the twelfth of June"

formality.description: Register key: formal, modern, casual, or playful

host_names.description: Host names for scenarios that include hosts. Two hosting parties are separated by " / ".

hosts_child.description: Partner whose parents are hosting. Defaults to couple_b for grooms-parents and couple_a for brides-parents or divorced-parents. Partner names never determine parentage.

reception_note.description: Optional final line, e.g. "Reception to follow"

scenario.description: Hosting-situation key. An absent value returns the available scenarios and formality options.

time.description: Time as it should read, e.g. "at four o’clock in the afternoon"

worship_space.description: Formal register: is the ceremony in a house of worship?

name: get_invitation_wording
title: Wedding Invitation Wording
